identity: An unedited school free-composition (student essay) on التسامح, written in UAE civic register for عام التسامح and closing on الشيخ زايد. Two paragraphs, first-person plural, heavy و/ف clause-chaining, one uncorrected spelling slip (نعسى for نسعى at i=19). This is doctrine §R, and specifically the same prompt family as doc_3ccbb7784a8d, which opens التسامح شيء مهم في الحياة against this document's التسامح شيء أساسي بالنسبة لنا. §R band = 20-35 tokens; recorded bias in this register = 2x over-cutting; recorded register note = these authors under-punctuate, so there are FEWER boundaries than the topic structure suggests.
law: Default is WELD (LAW 0''); cut only for a nameable non-connective reason. و, ف, ثم and fronted adverbials are never reasons (LAWS 1-2); trailing circumstantials, appositions, relative tails and honorific+name never split (LAWS 3-4, A1). The two free boundaries are the token before <NL> (i=83) and the final token (i=144). The one positive cue this text actually offers is information-structural: after a closed proposition of band length, a FULL re-nomination of the subject (دولة الإمارات at 42; الطلاب at 75 behind the demonstrative recap هذه الحصص; نحن كأبناء دولة الإمارات العربية المتحدة at 101) opens a new sentence, whereas a bare resumptive pronoun (فهي at 56) or a same-subject ف-verb (فنتمنى at 120) stays inside. 144 real tokens over 6 boundaries = 24 tokens per segment, inside the §R band.
reasoning: i=13 البلدان, med. The sibling §R gold welded التسامح شيء مهم في الحياة to its منه-tail as one 12-token unit and I false-cut there, so the reflex to close an opening thesis is suspect. But that tail was 7 tokens; here what follows لذلك is a full independent deontic clause of 27 tokens with its own modal predicate and its own (1pl) agent, so welding yields 41 tokens, over band. My reason is closure plus length, not the connective لذلك, which is why this is med and not hi. || i=40 الإنسانية, hi. لذلك تسعى دولة الإمارات re-nominates a full new NP subject and turns the topic from what we must do to what the state does; the preceding stretch (main clause + من خلال PP + coordinated gerund + relative) is syntactically closed. Welding both 13 and 40 would leave a 70-token opening run, which no register in my LAW 6 table supports, so at least one of these two must cut and this is the stronger. || i=55, NOT cut. فهي is ف plus a resumptive pronoun for دولة الإمارات: LAW 2 makes ف evidence the writer was still inside the sentence, and a bare pronoun is a continuation device rather than a re-opening. || i=69 والإنجليزية, med. The genuinely contested site. Against cutting: B3 says a fronted وعندما-type adverbial does not open a segment, and LAW 1 forbids و as a reason. For cutting: وفي أثناء هذه الحصص is a demonstrative RECAP of حصص from the previous clause plus a brand-new actor الطلاب, and a writer re-nominates with a demonstrative precisely because a sentence closed; welding also leaves [41-83] at 43 tokens, over the §R band. I additionally discount B3 here because its fronted-وعندما clause is a batch-1 WELD claim formed while I was under-cutting 4.8:1, and batch 2 re-confirmed only the إلا أن half of that entry. Cut, but flagged. || i=83 الأخلاقية, hi. Mandatory: token immediately before <NL>. 100% over 41 documents. || i=99 العمرية, hi. لذلك نحن كأبناء دولة الإمارات العربية المتحدة is a full re-nomination of the subject and the move into the conclusion; the preceding clause closes on a relative tail التي تشمل جميع الفئات العمرية. || i=119, NOT cut, and this is the site I most expect to be wrong about. Cutting before فنتمنى would split the closing 45-token peroration into 20 + 25, both dead-centre in the §R band, and that arithmetic tidiness is exactly the trap LAW 2 was written for. فنتمنى is ف with an unchanged 1pl subject and لهم is anaphoric to قادتنا الأعزاء four tokens earlier. My only reasons to cut are a connective and a token count, and checklist item 2 says neither is a reason. Weld, and accept a long peroration as a §R under-punctuation effect. || i=129, NOT cut. تزامنا مع عامنا هذا is a trailing circumstantial adjunct of the وذلك / خاصة / وفقا لـ family (LAW 4), and عام التسامح المقتبس من والدنا المغفور له الشيخ زايد رحمه الله is an appositive tail (LAW 3) in which the honorific-plus-name الشيخ زايد never splits (A1). || i=144 الله, hi. Mandatory final token. || Calibration check: 6 boundaries, segment lengths 14, 27, 29, 14, 15, 45, mean 24. Two segments sit below band and one above; the mean is central. Given a recorded 2x over-cut bias in §R I deliberately declined the two extra cuts (55, 119) that would have flattened the variance, because both would have been connective-motivated.
